name: mother_media_attachment_import
title: Import a host file for owner review
description: Use when your host passes a file the owner attached or selected through this tool's file parameter as {download_url, file_id} (for example a ChatGPT conversation or Library file). Mother downloads the original from the host's file service, hashes the real bytes, streams them with the ordinary attachment protocol and stops at pending_owner_review. Use a new operation UUID and the revision from mother_get_record. Never invent a link or file reference. Typing a file ID as text is not a file: the owner must attach the file to the current conversation (upload or pick it from the Library) so the host can pass it. Hosts that can read a local file should use the selected-file helper or chunked uploads instead; with no bytes at all, call mother_media_attachment_prepare without file for the owner handoff. Report success only after mother_media_attachment_status shows a verified receipt. Check mother_get_capabilities.mediaAttachmentBridge.trust first: when routineAttachments is "automatic", a confirmed, in-policy submission returns approved with a verified receipt; otherwise it returns pending_owner_review with reviewReason.

association.description: Your own judgement of the memory match. Only "confirmed" can commit without owner review, and only under an owner-granted trust policy. Use "uncertain" whenever the match rests on dates or guesses.

initiation.description: "owner_request" when the owner asked for this attachment; "autonomous" for self-initiated backfill. Autonomous work commits automatically only under autonomous_gardening trust.
